a2-81.title: Communicative Challenge: What Hurts?
a2-81.scenario: On the train home from Szeged Meg does not feel well. Károly asks what hurts. Your head, your eyes and your ears hurt.
a2-81.prompt: Tell Károly which parts of your body hurt: your head, your eyes and your ears.
cues: Name three body parts that hurt
a2-81.target: Fáj a fejem, a szemem és a fülem.
a2-81.english: My head, my eyes and my ears hurt.
a2-81.canDo: I can name the main parts of the body.

a2-82.title: Communicative Challenge: I Don't Feel Well
a2-82.scenario: Károly asks Meg how she is feeling on the train. You (Meg) feel unwell, you have a fever and you are coughing.
a2-82.prompt: Tell Károly that you feel unwell, that you have a fever and that you are coughing.
cues: Say you have a fever and a cough
a2-82.target: Rosszul érzem magam. Lázam van, és köhögök.
a2-82.english: I feel unwell. I have a fever, and I'm coughing.
a2-82.canDo: I can say how I'm feeling, well or unwell.

a2-83.title: Communicative Challenge: What's Wrong?
a2-83.scenario: On the train Károly looks pale. You (Meg) ask him what is wrong, where exactly it hurts, and since when.
a2-83.prompt: Ask Károly what is wrong, where exactly it hurts, and since when.
a2-83.target: Mi a baj? Hol fáj pontosan? Mióta fáj?
a2-83.english: What's wrong? Where exactly does it hurt? Since when has it hurt?
a2-83.canDo: I can ask someone what's wrong and where it hurts.

a2-84.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Doctor's
a2-84.scenario: Back in Budapest, Meg goes to the doctor's surgery. The doctor asks, in formal speech, what the matter is. You (Meg) say that your throat has hurt for two days and that you have a fever.
a2-84.prompt: Tell the doctor that your throat has hurt for two days and that you have a fever.
cues: Say how long your throat has hurt
a2-84.target: Két napja fáj a torkom, és lázam van.
a2-84.english: My throat has hurt for two days, and I have a fever.
a2-84.canDo: I can describe my symptoms formally to a doctor.

a2-85.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Pharmacy
a2-85.scenario: Meg and Károly stop at a pharmacy near the station. The pharmacist asks how she can help. Your throat hurts and you have a fever.
a2-85.prompt: Tell the pharmacist what hurts and ask whether there is something for a fever.
cues: Say your throat hurts and you have a fever
Ask for something for the fever
a2-85.target: Fáj a torkom, és lázam van. Van valami láz ellen?
a2-85.english: My throat hurts, and I have a fever. Is there something for a fever?
a2-85.canDo: I can ask for something for a specific ailment at the pharmacy.

a2-85-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Feeling Ill
a2-85-consolidation.scenario: Meg is at the pharmacy. The pharmacist asks what is wrong. You feel unwell, your throat has hurt for two days, and you want something for the fever.
a2-85-consolidation.prompt: Tell the pharmacist how you feel, how long your throat has hurt, and ask for something for a fever.
cues: Say how long your throat has hurt
Ask for something for a fever
a2-85-consolidation.target: Rosszul érzem magam. Két napja fáj a torkom. Van valami láz ellen?
a2-85-consolidation.english: I feel unwell. My throat has hurt for two days. Is there something for a fever?
a2-85-consolidation.canDo: I can name the main parts of the body and say what hurts.
